mapper.select: select ca.id, bi.book_name as bookName, bc.chapter_name as chapterName, bc.chapter_content as chapterContent, bc.word_count as wordCount, ca.author_id as authorId, ai.author_name as authorName, ui.nick_name as auditAdminName, ca.audit_remark as auditRemark, ca.audit_status as auditStatus, ca.create_time as subTime, ca.audit_time as auditTime from chapter_audit ca inner join book_chapter bc on ca.chapter_id = bc.id and ca.book_id = bc.book_id inner join book_info bi on ca.book_id = bi.id inner join author_info ai on ca.author_id = ai.id left join user_info ui on ca.audit_admin_id = ui.id where ca.id = #{auditId} and ca.audit_status = #{auditStatus}
